scripts.png-worker: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const w=require('./server/png-worker'); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const {createClient}=require('@supabase/supabase-js'); (async()=>{const m=process.env.SUPABASE_URL.match(/https:\/\/([^.]+)\.supabase\.co/); const pool=new Pool({host:'aws-0-ap-northeast-1.pooler.supabase.com',port:6543,database:'postgres',user:'postgres.'+m[1],password:process.env.SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD,ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}}); const sup=createClient(process.env.SUPABASE_URL, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY); const r=await w.processDirtyChunks(pool, sup, {limit:20}); console.log(r); await pool.end();})()"
